verdict.rationale: Evidence only includes generic marketing claims about 'smart power efficiency' and battery lasting 'unplugged' (docs-8, docs-21), with no independent battery-life benchmarks, no mention of fanless designs, or specific device examples demonstrating thin/quiet form factors. Missing for 10: independent battery-life test results, specific fanless/low-power OEM device examples, quantified all-day-battery claims (hours), and third-party corroboration of thermal/noise characteristics.
